verdict.rationale: Orama documents `insertMultiple` for bulk-inserting large numbers of documents without blocking the event loop, and Orama Cloud's data-source model implies batch loading, but there is no evidence of any async task/job API or status endpoint to track when a bulk-import of millions of documents completes. missing for 10: async task tracking API, job status/completion polling, evidence of scale to millions of documents, throughput/performance benchmarks.
